title: SCPN Stellarator Core
description: Governed device-family repository for stellarator, heliotron, and torsatron configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model and diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
